abort.already_configured: This SmartyPlants account is already set up.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SmartyPlants server. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: That API key was rejected. Check it and try again.

data_description.api_key: Create this in the SmartyPlants app, under Settings. It identifies your account to Home Assistant.

user.description: Enter the API key from the SmartyPlants app, under Settings.
user.title: Connect SmartyPlants

data_description.webhook_secret: The signing secret the SmartyPlants app shows after you add the webhook URL. It is used to verify that pushed updates really came from SmartyPlants.

webhook.description:
Optional: for instant updates instead of polling every minute, add this webhook URL in the SmartyPlants app, then paste the signing secret it gives you below.

`{webhook_url}`

Leave the secret empty to use polling only.
webhook.title: Enable live updates

invalid_auth.message: The SmartyPlants API key was rejected. Enter a new one to reconnect.
